module: Lifecycle callbacks of the "pause.*" routes of the new pause menu (Vue UI router). The router calls these hooks when the user enters, mounts, or leaves a pause, vehicle configuration, big map or photo mode route. The module builds the layout data (top tabs, title, breadcrumb, main/side content/panels, rail) by delegating to the ui_pause_providers_routeData_* providers, handles the simulation pause request, the pause camera (ui_pause_camera) and photo mode sessions.
notes: No function is meant to be called by hand: all are hooks called by the router with (context, toRoute, fromRoute, data), where data is the table the hook fills (data.layoutMenu, data.pause, data.photomode).
In onPauseEnter, the route content is not computed (includeRouteContent = false); it is in onPauseMount (true).

The simulation is paused (simTimeAuthority.pushPauseRequest, id "ui_pause_home_tab") for pause, pause.system, pause.manageVehicles and pause.options; it is not paused for combined configuration (except unlisted routes), tuning, debug, paint, weather, simulation, replay and photomode.

The top tabs depend on the mode: career (Progression if available, History), otherwise Vehicle and Environment (filtered by gameplay_discover_firstDrive_capabilities during the first drive), Multiplayer if MP exists in freeroam, then mod tabs via ui_pause_actions.getVisibleModTabs().
onPauseEnter calls dump("not a pause route") for non-pause routes (leftover debug left in the code).
attachPhotomodeRouteData contains a TODO: workaround to provide fresh photo mode data on enter, because onMount can arrive late.

dependencies.desc: Extensions loaded before this module: ui_pause_actions, routeData providers (system, home, career, vehicle, environment, multiplayer, gamemodes, photomode), ui_pause_providers_trafficControls, ui_pause_providers_vehicleTabInteractions, ui_pause_photomode, ui_pause_vehicleConfigurationOccupants.

onPauseEnter.desc: Entry hook for a pause.* route. Ignores non-pause routes. Notifies vehicleTabInteractions, fills data.layoutMenu and data.pause without route content, updates the simulation pause request, and starts ui_pause_camera on the root "pause" route.

data.desc: Data table to fill for the UI

onPauseMount.desc: Hook called when the route component is mounted. Fills data.layoutMenu with the full route content, updates the simulation pause and calls ui_pause_camera.beginPauseSession().

onPauseLeave.desc: Exit hook of a pause route. Notifies vehicleTabInteractions, adjusts the pause request according to the target route, stops ui_pause_camera if leaving "pause", and ends the camera session (endPauseSession) if leaving the pause routes entirely.

onVehicleConfigurationLeave.desc: Exit of a vehicle configuration route: calls onPauseLeave; if the target route is not itself a configuration route, ends the ui_pause_vehicleConfigurationOccupants session, the render_splitScreen solo view and clears core_vehicle_configTarget (reason "routeLeave").

onVehicleConfigTargetChanged.desc: Hook emitted when the configuration target changes. Does something only if the target disappears (current nil) with the reason "vehicleDestroyed": closes the solo view and, if the current route is a configuration route, returns to the return route (previous.returnRoute or "pause.vehicle").

reason.desc: Reason for the change, for example vehicleDestroyed

onPauseBigmapLeave.desc: Exit of the big map route: closes the map (freeroam_vueBigMap.exitBigMap, otherwise freeroam_bigMapMode.exitBigMap(true)) then calls onPauseLeave.

onPhotomodeEnter.desc: Entry into a pause.photomode route: calls onPauseEnter, ui_pause_photomode.beginPhotomodeSession(), attaches the photo mode data (data.photomode) then ui_pause_photomode.onPhotomodeRouteEnter(routeName).

onPhotomodeMount.desc: Mounting of a photo mode route: calls onPauseMount then copies the photomode data to data.photomode.

onPhotomodeLeave.desc: Exit of a photo mode route. If the target is still a pause.photomode.* route, only calls onPauseLeave. Otherwise notifies ui_pause_photomode.onPhotomodeRouteLeave, ends the session (endPhotomodeSession) then calls onPauseLeave.
